description: This file defines the ConfigHandlerExtra class, a Drupal form class for configuring extra settings for a Views UI item via AJAX.

classes.name: ConfigHandlerExtra
classes.description: A Drupal form class for configuring extra options for a Views UI item via AJAX.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ConfigHandlerExtra, sets type and ID.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form for configuring the view handler.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form array with options and handler-specific form elements.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, triggers rerender if errors exist.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updates handler options, and caches the view.
